title: Disaster Recovery Warm Standby Cluster Failover
precondition: Primary cloud region experiences catastrophic data center failure.
steps: 1. Trigger automated DNS and database failover to secondary cloud region.
expected_result: Standby MAM engine assumes active traffic within 120 seconds; zero dropped trades (RPO = 0s, RTO < 120s).
actual_result: Warm standby failover architecture guarantees RPO = 0s (zero lost trades) and RTO < 120s via active-passive database replication.
